package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "io/ioutil"
    "net/http"

func main() {
    url := "https://api.example.com/v2/auth/login"
    payload := map[string]string{
        "username": "user@example.com",
        "password": "s3cr3t",
    }
    body, _ := json.Marshal(payload)

    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

    client := &http.Client{}
    resp, err := client.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()

    data, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
        var result map[string]interface{}
        json.Unmarshal(data, &result)
        fmt.Println("Token:", result["access_token"])
    } else {
        fmt.Printf("Login failed: %d %s\n", resp.StatusCode, string(data))
    }
}

    url := "https://api.example.com/v2/auth/login"
    payload := map[string]string{
        "username": "user@example.com",
        "password": "s3cr3t",
    }
    body, _ := json.Marshal(payload)

    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

    client := &http.Client{}
    resp, err := client.Do(req)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()

    data, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
        var result map[string]interface{}
        json.Unmarshal(data, &result)
        fmt.Println("Token:", result["access_token"])
    } else {
        fmt.Printf("Login failed: %d %s\n", resp.StatusCode, string(data))
    }
}

Quickstart | Installation | API Reference

Installation

To install the latest stable version of the SDK, run:

pip install myapp-sdk==2.4.1

The SDK requires Python ≥3.8 and the requests library (≥2.25.0).

Verifying the installation

After installation, you can verify the package version and import the main client class:

import myapp_sdk
print(myapp_sdk.__version__)  # → 2.4.1

from myapp_sdk import Client
client = Client(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")
print(client.status())

Common pitfalls

  • ImportError: cannot import name 'Client' – This usually occurs when an older version of the SDK is still present in /usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/. Remove any stale copies: 
    pip uninstall -y myapp-sdk
rm -rf /usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/myapp_sdk*
pip install myapp-sdk==2.4.1
  • Version mismatch – Ensure that requests is up‑to‑date: 
    pip install -U "requests>=2.25.0"
  • Virtual environment confusion – Activate the correct venv before installing: 
    source ~/myproject/.venv/bin/activate

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Example script demonstrating basic usage of the MyApp SDK.
"""

import os
import sys
import logging

# Ensure the SDK is importable
try:
    from myapp_sdk import Client
except ImportError as e:
    sys.stderr.write(f"ImportError: {e}\\n")
    sys.stderr.write("Make sure you have installed the SDK with pip and are using the correct Python environment.\\n")
    sys.exit(1)

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def main():
    api_key = os.getenv("MYAPP_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        logger.error("Environment variable MYAPP_API_KEY is not set.")
        sys.exit(1)

    client = Client(api_key=api_key)
    try:
        status = client.status()
        logger.info(f"API status: {status}")
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Failed to retrieve status from MyApp API")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Overview

All API requests must be authenticated using a JWT token. Tokens are issued via the /v2/token endpoint.

Python SDK Example

Install the SDK:

pip install myapp-sdk==2.3.1

Use the SDK to obtain a token:

import myapp.auth as auth

client = auth.Client(
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    client_secret="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
    api_base="https://api.myapp.com/v2"
)

try:
    token = client.get_token(scopes=["read", "write"])
    print("Access token:", token.access_token)
except auth.AuthenticationError as e:
    # Traceback will point to the SDK source file
    # /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/myapp/auth.py:45
    print("Failed to obtain token:", e)

Prerequisites

  • Python 3.8+

$ source .venv/bin/activate
$ pip install example-sdk==3.4.2

$ pip install example-sdk

Or install from the local wheel:


$ pip install /opt/example-sdk/dist/example_sdk-3.4.2-py3-none-any.whl

import example_sdk

# Initialize the client
client = Client(
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
    endpoint="https://api.example.com/v1"
)

# Simple health check
status = client.health()
print("Service status:", status)
